examples.en: Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?
The warehouse was a front for drug traffickers.

examples.text: Кто забыл запереть дверь от склада?
examples.en: Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?

examples.text: Мы используем наш подвал только как склад.
examples.en: We only use our basement for storage.

examples.text: Том отнёс две коробки на склад.
examples.en: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
